name: DashCore Bismuth Bridge
description: Optional CPU-side Bismuth-compatible trigger-state mirror for Android64. Observes vanilla Move, Rotate, Follow, Toggle, Alpha, Color and Pulse state while preserving original gameplay and rendering. Compute Shaders and replacement draw submission are not enabled.

capture-object-diagnostics.name: Capture object diagnostics
capture-object-diagnostics.description: Enables per-frame read-only object and sprite capture for the A/B comparison. When disabled, DashCore only sends level lifecycle markers while Launcher Diagnostics measures the game. Changes apply from the next level.

enable-bismuth-trigger-state-adapter.name: Enable Bismuth trigger-state adapter
enable-bismuth-trigger-state-adapter.description: Mirrors vanilla Move, Rotate, Follow, Toggle, Alpha, Color and Pulse state into CPU group-combination snapshots. Does not replace trigger processing or render anything. Intended for alpha validation; disabled by default.
